SELECT * FROM ( SELECT BUYER, INV_NO, INV_TYPE AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C002' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKOLOG001' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, INV_NO, '2' AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM WMSIVDT A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT DISTINCT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C002' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRKOLOG001' AND FLAG = 'Y') AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ) Z ORDER BY Z.BUYER, Z.INV_NO

SELECT A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, '10000191' AS LIFNR, A.INV_DATE AS LFDAT, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN 'C' WHEN A.STATUS = 'R' THEN 'U' WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'D' END AS TYPE FROM ICOMIVHD A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO

SELECT A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, B.INV_NO AS LIFEX, TO_NUMBER(B.INV_SEQ) * 10 AS POSNR, E.EBELN AS EBELN, E.EBELP AS EBELP, E.MATNR AS MATNR, B.INV_QTY AS MENGE, E.MEINS AS MEINS, '' AS LICHN, 'KR' AS SPE_HERKL, '' AS HSDAT, REPLACE(D.IRS_NO,'-','') AS STCD2, D.COM_NAME_LOC AS NAME1, '' AS TEXT1, '' AS TEXT2 FROM ICOMIVHD A INNER JOIN ICOMIVDT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = A.INV_NO ) INNER JOIN ICOMPODT C ON (1 = 1 AND C.BUYER = B.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND C.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ ) INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY D ON (1 = 1 AND D.COM_CODE = A.AGENT ) INNER JOIN IF_KOLON_EKPO E ON (1 = 1 AND TRIM(E.EBELN) = C.LEGACY_PO_NO AND E.EBELP = C.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND E.KEP_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(KEP_SEQ) FROM IF_KOLON_EKPO WHERE TRIM(EBELN) = TRIM(E.EBELN) AND EBELP = E.EBELP) ) WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.INV_TYPE = '0' AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY B.INV_NO, B.INV_SEQ

SELECT DISTINCT A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, '10000191' AS LIFNR, A.INV_DATE AS LFDAT, CASE WHEN A.STATUS = 'C' THEN 'C' WHEN A.STATUS = 'R' THEN 'U' WHEN A.STATUS = 'D' THEN 'D' END AS TYPE FROM WMSIVDT A WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO

SELECT A.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL AS VBELN, A.INV_NO AS LIFEX, TO_NUMBER(A.INV_SEQ) * 10 AS POSNR, E.EBELN AS EBELN, E.EBELP AS EBELP, E.MATNR AS MATNR, A.INV_QTY AS MENGE, E.MEINS AS MEINS, '' AS LICHN, 'KR' AS SPE_HERKL, '' AS HSDAT, REPLACE(D.IRS_NO,'-','') AS STCD2, D.COM_NAME_LOC AS NAME1, '' AS TEXT1, '' AS TEXT2 FROM WMSIVDT A INNER JOIN ICOMPODT B ON (1 = 1 AND B.BUYER = A.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ AND B.PROCESS_TYPE = A.PROCESS_TYPE AND B.STATUS IN ('C','R') ) INNER JOIN ICOMCMPY D ON (1 = 1 AND D.COM_CODE = A.AGENT ) INNER JOIN IF_KOLON_EKPO E ON (1 = 1 AND TRIM(E.EBELN) = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND E.EBELP = B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND E.KEP_SEQ = (SELECT MAX(KEP_SEQ) FROM IF_KOLON_EKPO WHERE TRIM(EBELN) = TRIM(E.EBELN) AND EBELP = E.EBELP) ) WHERE A.BUYER = #BUYER# AND A.INV_NO = #INV_NO# AND A.SND_CHK = 'N' ORDER BY A.INV_NO, A.INV_SEQ
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMIVHD SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL#, SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO#
UPDATE WMSIVDT SET LEGACY_IV_SERIAL = #LEGACY_IV_SERIAL#, SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND INV_NO = #INV_NO#
